reviews.title: First class service
reviews.text: I had an absolutely fantastic experience visiting Bluehawk Automotive to view a Porsche, and I honestly couldn’t be more impressed with the level of service I received. From my very first enquiry, the team were incredibly quick to respond and amazing at answering all of my questions. Communication was excellent throughout, and every enquiry was dealt with promptly, professionally, and with genuine enthusiasm. They made me feel like a valued customer from the very beginning. What really stood out to me was the professionalism and friendliness of the staff. They created a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere, which made the whole experience enjoyable rather than feeling like a typical dealership visit. It’s clear that customer service is genuinely important to the team at Bluehawk Automotive. The combination of excellent communication, attention to detail, professionalism, and a beautiful Porsche made this a first-class experience. I would highly recommend Bluehawk Automotive to anyone looking for a quality vehicle and, just as importantly, a dealership that genuinely cares about its customers.

reviews.title: Rude, incompetent, disorganised.
reviews.text: Horrible.Worst experience ever, drove 4 1//2 hours from Manchester already gave them a heads up. Got there no one was interested to even look at us, had to approach a guy who was struggling to find keys as they have a system whereby all the car keys thrown into a box together so they takes ages to find one they need so disorganised.Finally found the keys and the car wasn’t ready as expected, didn’t have anything to say eventually took it for a test drive the guy was on his phone the whole time most disinterested grumpy car salesman I met. Just on WhatsApp or Snapchat on his phone tried to ask him a few questions about the car, he couldn’t string sentence together just mumble rapped under his breath one word answers.I asked him where Zain is the person we spoke to on the phone and who the owner is he said no he just helps out. No interest whatsoever.After the drive wanted to see another car as came to see 2 that day took him 30 mins to find the key as he just disappeared again in the end couldn’t be bothered getting it out as he had to remove another car to get it out and would take him probs 30 mins to find that key for that so I just said leave it.He Clearly didn’t want to be there, couldn’t be bothered seem like he wanted us to go, worse thing bought my family with me as well with the intention to purchase but he was actually clueless no consideration.Not even acknowledgement of us driving 4 hours to come the see car so let me put a bit of effort in.Was very disappointed, the owner needs to hire people who care about his business rather than family members just doing him a favour as this guy is doing more harm than good.Incompetent, disorganised and rude.I’ve already bought my car now from another garage which much better people skills and systems but still had to leave this review as it’s disrespectful customer service.From my experience this place is a joke.P.s I also called the week before was told to come on down, called on the day before I left early morning as it’s a long way only to be told the car’s been taken for works to be done. Good job I phoned again in the morning then!Joke of a place

reviews.text: Worst experience ever, showed up to view a car first of all car wasn’t there even though I called ahead and booked an appointment, when the car showed up it was dirty and absolutely reeked of the devils lettuce. When asked why the car wasn’t on site I was told that it was a SOR car ( later found out most of their cars are SOR and not actually owned by them ). What’s even worse is that most of these salesmen are not professional at all - just a bunch of hooligans and criminals. They were smoking out side and it was just very unprofessional at all. I understand we are in London and they may be a bit hip and relaxed but this was just a complet horror. Would NEVER BUY OR EVEN VISIT HERE AGAIN
